corpora.description: 78 real scenes from four stories, labelled twice by separate Claude reviewer passes under rubric v1
corpora.note: NOT human labels. pass1.json and pass2.json retain the two passes; consensus.json is merged and must not be treated as two independent raters.

corpora.description: Intended 12-scene human reference pilot, selected from the shortest scenes
corpora.note: The current file is a Claude main read, not a human label set. No human labels exist in the tree.

corpora.description: 12 public-domain masterpiece passages used as known-good controls
corpora.note: Controls for over-strictness; no label set is needed.

corpora.description: Deliberately injected defects used as the focused-critic sensitivity regression set
corpora.note: Sensitivity evidence only; not natural prevalence and not a false-alarm estimate.

corpora.description: One-book fact-retrieval evaluation, 40 queries over 30 scenes, three relevant scenes per query
corpora.note: Single-book baseline; no cross-book holdout or user-perceived relevance study.

corpora.description: Exploratory within-scene ConStory-Checker probe: 20 model-labelled positives and 20 model-labelled negatives
corpora.note: Labels come from another LLM checker, not humans. The 20 positives were sampled from that checker's own findings, so this is a negative signal about transfer, not a prevalence estimate.

nonEvidence.reason: Relevance is defined by the same TF-IDF cosine the fixture then ranks with, so MRR 1.000 is true by construction.
scoreTest assigns each dimension score = expected.minScores, so the report measures fixture drift, not model quality.

claims.statement: The production scene gate fails only on continuity or voice; show_tell, pacing and emotional_goal are still judged but are advisory.
Any load-bearing dimension below 7, or two or more major issues, fails a scene; the mean must also clear the workspace threshold.
The focused critic caught 133 of 145 deliberately planted defects.
claims.note: Sensitivity on injected defects only; not a natural-prevalence or false-alarm estimate. Last measured run; not rerun for this snapshot.

claims.statement: An earlier gate caught none of the continuity or voice problems the two reviewer passes agreed on across 78 real scenes.
claims.note: Historical. Reviewer labels were Claude passes, not human labels; the gate has changed since.

claims.statement: The gate failed 12 of the 78 reviewer-labelled real scenes.
claims.note: Gate-failure count, not recall of reviewer-identified problems. Measured under the gate at that time.

claims.statement: The current continuity check caught 3 of the 17 continuity problems the reviewer passes identified.
claims.note: Reviewer labels only; no human reference. Does not establish precision on natural prose. Last measured run; not rerun for this snapshot.

claims.statement: The pre-31 gate failed 11 of 12 public-domain masterpiece passages.
claims.note: Historical. It motivated demoting show_tell, pacing and emotional_goal to advisory.

claims.statement: After the advisory demotion, the gate failed 0 of 12 masterpiece passages.
claims.note: Last measured run; not rerun for this snapshot.

claims.statement: The two Claude reviewer passes agree substantially per dimension; agreement is within-model, not human-human.
claims.value: continuity .75, voice .66, show_tell .68, pacing .85, emotional_goal .89; overall Keep/Revise .59
claims.note: 78-scene overlap. Voice has only n=46 usable pairs and 30/32 unsure marks; this is a same-model consistency check, not human validation.

claims.statement: A third Claude read of the 12 pilot scenes agreed with the two reviewer passes on 42 of 50 decisions.
claims.note: Same model family as the reviewers. It is a consistency check, not a human check; one scene had been seen before.

claims.statement: No human labels have been collected; the 12-scene main read is by Claude, not a human.
claims.note: At least two humans must independently label an overlap before human-human agreement can be reported.

claims.statement: The P0-A calibration run has not been executed; the local consensus artifact is merged and lacks separate passA/passB labels.
claims.note: The runner refuses merged labels. Two named human adjudicators and explicit approval are required; recording names is not proof the exercise happened.

claims.statement: The older scene-retrieval evaluation reported MRR 1.000.
claims.note: Circular query/scene construction. Run only via `npm run smoke:scene`; the artifact is stamped non-evidence.

claims.statement: The later 40-query, one-book fact-retrieval baseline scored MRR 0.671.
claims.note: 40 queries, 30 scenes, one book, three relevant scenes per query. Useful narrow baseline, not broad validation. The 2026-11-06 harness adds a multi-book manifest, pooled metrics, bootstrap intervals, hard negatives and noise queries, but this value is still the old one-book result; no cross-book run is claimed.

claims.statement: A critic issue whose quoted span (at least 12 alphanumeric characters) is absent from the draft is marked quoteVerified=false, excluded from the major-issue count, and counted as critic_unverified.
claims.note: This reduces the cost of a fabricated quote. It does not validate the gate against human readers, and issues without a quote are left untouched.

claims.statement: Background cloud-audit consent is stored on the project row and is not part of the sync payload; the transport refuses a send whose caller passes no consent.
claims.note: Provider retention and jurisdiction remain the provider's terms. Consent is per device, so a second device must opt in itself.

claims.statement: Two clients follow an explicit conflict contract: clean rows follow the server, dirty rows win on pull, in-flight edits stay pending, root tombstones delete clean subtrees and preserve dirty subtrees.
claims.note: No CRDT and no field merge; simultaneous edits to the same row are last-writer-wins.

claims.statement: The backend SceneLabel has an optional SubsectionId with a migration and upsert tests, and local labels prefer a stable sceneId; labels are still not synced.
claims.note: Partial identity only. There is no label mapper or sync protocol, so this is not cross-device identity.

claims.statement: The local within-scene ConStory-Checker probe flagged 1 of 20 sampled positives, located none, and flagged 0 of 20 negatives.
claims.note: The positive samples were themselves another LLM checker's findings, and the raw data lives under gitignored reports/. It is a negative signal about transfer to scene-length local critique, not a human-grounded failure or a prevalence estimate.

claims.statement: The earlier claim that the fact ledger made contradictions worse by +.67 per scene at p=.25 was retracted.
claims.note: The difference came from old-judge false alarms, not the ledger. Do not cite it as evidence of harm.

claims.statement: A wider memory experiment measured 3.5x more context, but its callback outcome was underpowered and did not establish better prose.
claims.note: Context increase measured; the callback proxy was poor. Do not present it as improved continuity.

claims.statement: Reading token probabilities instead of sampled scores separated dimensions better in an internal probe (pooled AUC 0.77 to 0.91).
claims.note: Internal probe; transfer to the production critic prompt is not measured.

claims.statement: The quality-regression pipeline sets each dimension score to its expected minimum.
claims.note: Fixture and pipeline smoke path, not independent model-quality evidence.

claims.statement: Full local recovery backup exists and round-trips prose; it is not an open core gap.
claims.note: Restore UX and very large/corrupt backups remain untested.

claims.statement: The frontend suite passed on the reviewed working tree.
The backend suite passed on the reviewed working tree.
